findings.message: `mock_dialect = MagicMock()` stands in for `Db2Dialect` here and is then patched onto `hook.dialect`, so `mock_dialect.get_column_names.assert_called_once_with("TEST_TABLE", "MY_SCHEMA")` would keep passing even if that method were renamed or its signature changed on the real dialect. Spec it - `MagicMock(spec=Db2Dialect)` - the way `MagicMock(spec=DbApiHook)` is already used in tests/unit/ibm/db2/dialects/test_db2.py.
